result:
If I could change just one thing, it would be how people relate to each other.

Not the systems, not the technology, not even the resources — though those matter — but the default setting in our minds.

I would make it so people could truly feel safe being vulnerable with each other. To listen without preparing a rebuttal, to disagree without dehumanizing, to admit "I don't know" or "I was wrong" without shame.

Because almost every other problem in the world is downstream of that one. Poverty, conflict, polarization, loneliness, environmental harm — they all get worse when we see each other as threats to manage instead of people to understand.

If empathy became the reflex instead of suspicion, everything else would become solvable much faster. We'd share more generously, cooperate more readily, and care for the planet and each other because we could actually feel connected to them.

What about you? If you had that one change, what would you pick?
